_stage_ceiling_doc: Set by the builder of this step: one mod's measured dollars at the offline build (every run the status page places there, plus this step's launches, a run with no measured dollars counted at its cap) past this line stops the step on that mod, with a Needs Conductor line. About four capped runs.
